headline: Personnel-only consent agenda and public input session.
summary: The meeting covers a personnel item on the consent agenda and a public input period for comments on school and educational matters.
items: Public Input (up to 3 minutes per speaker, 30 minute period)
location: The Green Ladle, 156 East Ave., Lewiston
plain_text:
** AGENDA** 
PERSONNEL ONLY 
SCHOOL COMMITTEE MEETING SCHEDULED FOR MONDAY, AUGUST 24, 2026 
AT THE GREEN LADLE, 156 EAST AVE., LEWISTON 
Note:  
*A review of all general session meetings can be located at www.lewistonpublicschools.org or copies can be requested at a cost of 10 
cents per page.   
**This Agenda includes estimated time for each agenda item which is being used only as a guide to keep the meeting on schedule. 
***Video Notice: This meeting is being recorded and can be viewed on the internet from a link at www.lewistonpublicschools.org 
****Public Comment should be done in person. 
 
1. Call meeting to order on or about 5:30 pm until approximately 6:30. Pledge of Allegiance. 
 
2. School Committee Member Introductions. 
 
3. Consent Agenda: (a) Personnel 
 
4. Public Input: (Note: Members of the public may address the School Committee for up to 3 minutes on non-agenda 
items now and on agenda items later. Speakers must adhere to our public comment policy (BEDH), which is available 
in the back of the room or on the LPS website. These meetings exist to conduct school committee business. The 
purpose of public comment is to share thoughts on school and educational matters. Committee members and school 
staff will not reply during this time. Comments must be directed to the Chair and be civil. By law, comments may not 
pertain to specific staff or students; comments about individuals must be directed privately to the appropriate LPS 
staff. Student privacy must be maintained. The public comment period is 30 minutes unless extended due to unusual 
circumstances. Priority goes to Lewiston residents and parents, students, or employees of LPS. Before starting, please 
state your name, town/city of residence, and affiliation to LPS. 
 
5. Adjourn 
 
ADA Notice: This school district will accommodate members of the public with special needs to participate fully in this 
meeting. Please contact Executive Assistant Cheryl Cornelio (795-4100, Ext.4002) if you have such needs.
